📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 up_close：close > close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 down_close：~up_close
  3. 计算 range_：high - low
  4. 计算 win：20
  5. 计算 up_sum：range_.where(up_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  6. 计算 down_sum：range_.where(down_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  7. 计算 up_count：up_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  8. 计算 down_count：down_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  9. 计算 up_avg：up_sum / up_count
  10. 计算 down_avg：down_sum / down_count
  11. 计算 ratio：np.log((up_avg + 1e-12) / (down_avg + 1e-12))
  12. 计算 vol_avg：volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).mean()
  13. 计算 vol_max：vol_avg.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).max()
  14. 计算 vol_weight：vol_avg / vol_max
  15. 计算 factor：ratio * vol_weight
  16. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_range_asym_log_vol(df): df_copy = df.copy() up_close = df_copy["str">'close'] > df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1) down_close = ~up_close range_ = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] win = 20 min_per = 5 up_sum = range_.where(up_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() down_sum = range_.where(down_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() up_count = up_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() down_count = down_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() up_avg = up_sum / up_count.replace(0, np.nan) down_avg = down_sum / down_count.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = np.log((up_avg + 1e-12) / (down_avg + 1e-12)) vol_avg = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean() vol_max = vol_avg.rolling(20, min_periods=10).max().replace(0, np.nan) vol_weight = vol_avg / vol_max factor = ratio * vol_weight factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_range_asym_log_vol'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_range_asym_log_vol']
